snippet.title: Rune Runners – 6 Minutes of Co-op Gameplay | Free Demo on Steam
snippet.description:
Play the free demo and wishlist Rune Runners on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3556940/Rune_Runners/

Two minutes of Rune Runners, played in two-player co-op. Two young mages light the rune torches together, mix water, fire, thunder and wind against the monsters, get each other back on their feet and step into the portal side by side.

Rune Runners is a colorful 3D platformer for one or two players on one couch. Between the worlds you come home to a village around the Rune Tree with a merchant, a tailor, a library and a boss arena. Every level works solo too.

The demo is free on Steam: play World 1, and get the code for the bonus world on our Discord. A wishlist is the best way to support the game, and Steam lets you know when the full game is out.

What's in the game
• 1–2 players: local co-op on one screen, or solo – Steam Remote Play Together for playing with a friend online
• 4 mages with water, fire, thunder and wind spells
• 10 worlds, 111 levels and 20 bosses
• Many collectibles
• Relaxed, Normal and Heroic difficulty, switchable at any time
• Full controller support with Xbox, PlayStation and Switch button prompts, or keyboard
• Interface in 31 languages

Links
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3556940/Rune_Runners/
Discord: https://discord.gg/gs9m9EgUc

Rune Runners is made by Pierogi Games.
